title: The Last Stand Narrows to the Child Rai Singh

blocks.text: The fighting grows still more desperate as losses mount around Natha Khehra. At the turning point Natha’s bow breaks, forcing him into close combat with the sword while mounted troops and muskets tighten the noose.

One by one the defenders fall until the scene contracts around the endangered child. Rai Singh survives the clash only by fleeing, stumbling, and hiding where the attackers assume no one could endure for long.

The page keeps the reader close to that vulnerability. What had been a battle narrative now becomes a survival narrative in which the future of a lineage hangs on one wounded child slipping through chaos.
